semiconductor_relevance: Medium — MIB GmbH provides measurement solutions that can be utilized in semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in liquid media management.
summary: MIB GmbH develops and manufactures measuring instruments and system solutions for liquid media, focusing on ultrasonic flow measurement. Their products, such as the Flowmax® instruments, are designed for precise volume dosing and batching of chemicals in semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Ultrasound flow measurement for liquid media
Consumption quantity recording and formula control
